description: List the recipes the user favourited on HelloFresh (recipe ids and when). Give a week to name the ones on that week’s menu with their menu index (hf_favorite_recipe / hf_unfavorite_recipe take that index). hf_suggest_meals and hf_weekly_plan already favour these recipes.

week.description: A delivery week (ISO, e.g. 2026-W49): items on that week’s menu are named with their menu index.

name: hf_list_favorites
